# Skybreaker: Orbital Arsenal v__VERSION__

**Call down the sky.** Eight orbital strike remotes with cinematic cameras, slow-motion impacts, custom sounds and a full config.

## What's new in v__VERSION__

__CHANGES__

## Download

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| **`skybreaker-__VERSION__.jar`** | The mod. Put it in your `mods` folder. |

**Requirements:** Minecraft `26.3`, [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) `0.19+`, [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api), Java 25.

## Install in 30 seconds

1. Install Fabric for Minecraft 26.3.
2. Drop **Fabric API** and **skybreaker-__VERSION__.jar** into `.minecraft/mods`.
3. Launch the game. Config is created at `config/skybreaker.json`.

## What's inside

| Remote | Effect |
|---|---|
| Orbital Railgun | Tungsten rod from orbit, pinpoint hit, huge crater |
| Satellite Laser | Sustained beam, ends in a massive detonation |
| Meteor Barrage | Rains meteors over a wide area |
| Singularity Cannon | Black hole drags in blocks and mobs, then collapses |
| EMP Pulse | Freezes mobs, blacks out lamps, wrecks redstone |
| Orbital Napalm | Thermite rain and a field of fire |
| Tactical Nuke | Long countdown, giant blast, mushroom cloud |
| Tracking Strike | Locks onto a mob or player and follows them |
| Targeting Chip | Off-hand item: remotes recharge 40% faster |

## Quick start

Aim at a block (up to 128 blocks), **right-click** to fire. Get items with:

```
/give @s skybreaker:orbital_railgun
/give @s skybreaker:satellite_laser
/give @s skybreaker:meteor_barrage
/give @s skybreaker:black_hole
/give @s skybreaker:emp_pulse
/give @s skybreaker:orbital_napalm
/give @s skybreaker:tactical_nuke
/give @s skybreaker:tracking_strike
/give @s skybreaker:targeting_chip
```

Recipes, config options and tips are in the [README](https://github.com/__REPO__#readme).

## Safe for servers

Set `"terrainDestruction": false` and `"damagePlayers": false` in `config/skybreaker.json` to keep the spectacle without the grief.

> **Warning:** these weapons are extremely destructive. Back up your world first.
